# Onslaught: New buff for all builds (English: onslaught)

![Onslaught: New buff for all builds (English: onslaught)](/uploads/473_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

The “Glow of the Ghoul” update on March 18, 2025 brings with it a new mechanic that can buff your damage enormously. You can now find some new perk cards under the name “Onsturm” (English: “onslaught”). Or changed perk cards. The **Gunslinger** and **Guerrilla** perks have all been completely changed and now only serve the "**Assault**" mechanic. Revolvers and pistols have been buffed accordingly so that you can now use them with more damage without perks. See: Buffs & Balancing

- A **rush** is basically a situation in which the player lands hits on one or more opponents. The rush is not limited to one opponent.
- The new legendary "**Rasend**" mod serves as the basis. This is now:*5% damage per stacked rush, maximum stack size +9.*
- Damage stacks during the rush. “Rasend” delivers the first **9 stacks**, i.e. 45% bonus damage.
- The perk card “Professional Gunslinger”: additional **+3 stacks**
- The perk card "Profi Guerrilla": additional **+3 stacks**
- And the perk card "Master Guerrilla": another **+5 stacks**
- This will give you a maximum of 20 stacks. You get +5% buff per stack, so overall you get **with 20 stacks 100% damage bonus**.
- A stack is added per attack hit, up to a maximum of 20.
- One stack is deducted every second without further hits.
- The number of stacks is displayed as a status symbol at the bottom right.
- If the **Onslaught Perk Cards are used without Rushing**, only the bonus of the respective Perk Cards stacks, but not the +5% bonus damage. This is only possible with Rasend.

In boss fights or events you can often maintain the 100% bonus permanently.

### Reverse Onslaught

The perk card "**Master Gunslinger**" causes the **reversal of the stacks** function and adds another **10 stacks**. This means that when selecting perks, the stacks are no longer counted up when hit, but instead they count up automatically (1 per second) until the maximum of 30 is reached. A stack is then deducted for each hit on an opponent. But one stack is added every second. This is particularly suitable for single-shot rifles and pistols. **At 30 stacks you have a damage bonus of 150%**.

### Onslaught is not limited to one build

If you want to use these perks, you are not limited to one build. This mechanic works in every build with every weapon type. You should only combine the perks sensibly, then all options are open to you.

There is also no limit, so the rush mechanic can be used by both humans and ghouls.

### Known weapons that now use Onslaught

- Track Rifle: **Ticket to Retaliation**
 
 - Furious, fast, lightweight construction, 2x magazine
 - Quest: Seeking Shelter
- Light Machine Gun: **Red Terror** - Raging, Des Killer, Nimble, 2x Magazine
 - Event: Dangerous pastime
- Flamethrower: **Boiling Point** - Furious, The Brawler, Nimble, The Pyromancer
 - Raid: Radiant Depths
- Submachine gun: **Elder mark** - Furious, Fast, Nimble
 - Event: Pack mule
- Revolutionary Sword: **Commander's Blade** - Furious, Fast, Agility
 - Survival Mode 2019 (Cut)
- Power Fist: **Facebreaker** - Furious, The Radaurabauken, Strength
 - Quest Reward: Knight's Penance
- Baseball Bat: **Mole Rat Bat** - Furious, Stabilized, Strength
 - Event: Seismic Activity
